title: User Authentication & Organization Onboarding
description: Implement Supabase Auth login, registration, and onboarding flow to capture business profile, default currency, and tax settings.
acceptanceCriteria: User can sign up and sign in with email and password
Onboarding form captures business name, tax ID, and default currency

steps.description: Build Auth and Onboarding UI with shadcn/ui
steps.details: Create LoginForm and OnboardingModal using Card, Input, Button, Select from shadcn/ui.
Use supabase.auth.signUp() and supabase.auth.signInWithPassword() in auth context.
